name: midnight-peaks
title: Midnight Peaks
description: A new arena under the aurora: icy ledges you jump up through, a frozen pit whose fan blows you back up to the middle, springs by the walls and a moving ledge high above. Uses the original springs, fans and platforms from your own copy; everything else is new art. Made by JARVIS as a Funny Furries modding example; source and format: github.com/jarvis-jhk/funny-furries/tree/main/mods
